posts.title: Italian-Style Chicken Cacciatore
posts.text:
This chicken cacciatore makes a warm, reliable midweek supper for one. Cooking just for yourself often leaves odd ingredients behind, but this recipe opens a pack of chestnut mushrooms using 100g. The partner recipe later in the week, French-style chicken chasseur, uses the rest of the mushrooms so nothing sits forgotten in the vegetable drawer.

Full recipe and shopping list via the link in our bio. Pictures made with AI.
